knowledge.content: Task: Identify and fix CWE vulnerability in /app/bottle.py file. Must create /app/report.jsonl with format: {"file_path": "/app/example.cpp", "cwe_id": ["cwe-123"]} containing all vulnerable items. After fixing, run `pytest -rA` to verify all tests pass.
Repository: Bottle - a WSGI micro web-framework for Python, distributed as single file module in /app/bottle.py
Fix requirement: Function must raise correct type of error when encountering invalid inputs instead of silently ignoring them or raising a generic exception.
Critical constraints: Exact files and exact CWE-ids must appear in /app/report.jsonl. Can overwrite original code file. Must make all test cases pass.
File structure discovered: /app/bottle.py (175KB main file), /app/test/ (test directory), pyproject.toml, Makefile present. Repository confirmed as Bottle WSGI framework.

Test suite: 367 test cases collected across 25 test files in /app/test/. Many tests use \r\n for multipart/environ/stpl parsing tests, but these validate protocol handling, not header injection prevention.
